ObjectDefinition.Query:
SELECT DISTINCT(project.Path) AS ProjectPath FROM Revisions revision JOIN Documents document ON revision.DocumentID = document.DocumentID LEFT JOIN DocumentsInProjects docInProj ON document.DocumentID = docInProj.DocumentID LEFT JOIN Projects project ON docInProj.ProjectID = project.ProjectID --LEFT JOIN CardExtensions cardExt on document.ExtensionID = cardExt.ExtensionID --LEFT JOIN Cards card on cardExt.CardID = card.CardID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT thistory.DocumentID /*CONCAT(thistory.DocumentID,'-',thistory.RevNr)*/ AS thistoryID, thistory.TransitionNr , thistory.Date AS modDate , status.Name , wf.Name As Workflow, thistory.Comment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY thistory.DocumentID ORDER BY thistory.RevNr DESC, thistory.TransitionNr DESC) AS rn FROM TransitionHistory thistory LEFT JOIN Transitions transitions ON thistory.TransitionID = transitions.TransitionID LEFT JOIN Status status ON transitions.Destination = status.StatusID LEFT JOIN Workflows wf ON status.WorkflowID = wf.WorkflowID ) fileStatus ON revision.DocumentID = fileStatus.thistoryID
WHERE document.Deleted = 0 AND docInProj.Deleted = 0 AND document.shared != 2 AND revision.Date IS NOT NULL --AND REVERSE(LEFT(REVERSE(document.Filename),CHARINDEX('.',REVERSE(document.Filename)))) IN ('.slddrw','.sldasm','.sldprt') --AND document.LatestRevisionNo = revision.RevNr AND COALESCE(fileStatus.rn,1) = 1 -- 50825 standard epmdocuments (LVO) --AND document.Filename IN ('T5165NTOS.SLDASM')
